title: Chase Brandon opens a CIA liaison operation in Hollywood
summary: Bryce Zabel tells of Chase Brandon opens a CIA liaison operation in Hollywood, about 1996-1997 at Hollywood, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Brandon guy shows up in Hollywood and he's opening up a some kind of CIA operation where they can advise people on things like this.
kicker. Chase Brandon, the official Hollywood CIA liaison, was cousins with Men in Black co-star Tommy Lee Jones.
tellings.difference: Adds that Brandon was a cousin of Men in Black co-star Tommy Lee Jones.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Chase Brandon setting up as the CIA's Hollywood liaison in 1996-97, around the time of Men in Black.

as_told.title: CIA Hollywood liaison Chase Brandon, cousin of Tommy Lee Jones, and Men in Black

plain: Bryce Zabel, a researcher of the history of Hollywood and UFOs, says that around 1996 and 1997 a man named Chase Brandon turned up in Hollywood and opened some kind of operation for the CIA, the US Central Intelligence Agency, to advise filmmakers on subjects like UFOs. The podcast host Jesse Michels repeats the story in 2026, calling Brandon the CIA's official Hollywood liaison. Michels adds that Brandon was a cousin of the actor Tommy Lee Jones, who co-starred in Men in Black, a film about secret agents who deal with aliens. People tell this because, if true, it suggests a spy agency had a hand in how movies show aliens.
